Name the E≥0-manifold entry Causal.SFALocal.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere: IsoChartsCoverDEC25 alone, no absolute minimality, no T2 or second countability. The comment's words 'on the future side, at its BTZ points too' are confirmed, and in a stronger form: E₀ and every E≥0-manifold have chronal future neighbours in every open set (Causal.E0.chronalFutureNeighbours, Causal.SFALocal.chronalFutureNeighbours).

questions: Scope of 'every E≥0-manifold the existing SingularFlatAxioms instances cover'. I stated the E≥0-manifold form under IsoChartsCoverDEC25 alone (Causal.SFALocal.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere). That covers every SingularFlatAxioms instance of the library: SFAManifolds.singularFlatAxioms and singularFlatAxioms_of_isAtlasCausalityDEC25 at E≥0-manifolds, SFALine.singularFlatAxioms_e0 at E₀-manifolds, SFAMassiveLine.singularFlatAxioms_of_massive, SFALocalE0.e0_singularFlatAxioms. Each reaches IsoChartsCoverDEC25 (SFALine.singularFlatAxioms_e0 through SFALocal.isoChartsCoverDEC25_of_e0); the instances outside DEC-25 (timelikeLine_singularFlatAxioms, CBG.flat_singularFlatAxioms, timeCylinder_singularFlatAxioms) are covered by the general form only. The form also covers non-minimal causalities with isomorphic charts, which are not SingularFlatAxioms. The SingularFlatAxioms route is kept as `example`s (scaffold/CausalScaffold/Model/E0ChronalNeighbour.lean:320, 325, 337, 341), not as theorems with the stronger hypotheses. If the keeper wants a named theorem per instance, each is one line.

Which side, stated as the reading I took. HasChronalNeighbour is an 'or', and the future disjunct is the one that holds everywhere. For the time reversal of E₀ (not an E≥0-manifold, ladder.toml:775) it is the past disjunct of the reversed causality, by dual_hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere (checked by an `example`).
kb_proposals: has_chronal_neighbour at E₀ and every E≥0-manifold (T-loc-e0-has-chronal-neighbour, Causal.Model.E0ChronalNeighbour after graduation): Causal.E0.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere; Causal.SFALocal.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere (IsoChartsCoverDEC25 alone: Z⁺ = M is a chart fact); Causal.Causality.SingularFlatAxioms.hasChronalNeighbourEverywhere. It is always the future disjunct. The past one holds iff p ∉ sing₀ (…Iminus_nonempty_iff), which at a manifold needs absolute minimality (kb/0135).

E₀ has chronal future neighbours in every open set and no chronal past neighbours (Causal.E0.chronalFutureNeighbours, not_chronalPastNeighbours, likewise SFALocal.* at E≥0-manifolds). Causal.E0.separates_chronalNeighbours is a model witness of has_chronal_neighbour ⇏ chronal_neighbours with push-up, GH, tarentin, plain and strong causality.

LocZplus D ⇒ D.ChronalFutureNeighbours is one line: fun V v hv => hZ V v hv V (V.isOpen.mem_nhds hv). Every model with a LocZplus lemma (E0LM.e0_locZplus, SFALocal.locZplus, SFALocalE0.locZplus) has the future-base one-sided neighbours.
